##### Project general facts

Bianca is a stunning masterpiece of modern living, a brilliantly designed community of elegant townhouses where beauty and comfort come together in perfect harmony. Residents can choose from a luxurious collection of 2, 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses, each thoughtfully crafted to offer generous, light-filled living spaces. As a wonderful touch of exclusivity, the 4 bedroom townhouses feature their very own private internal elevators, making everyday life effortlessly convenient and refined.

Life at Bianca is elevated by a truly world-class collection of amenities designed to feel like a resort you never have to leave. Families can enjoy large swimming pools and dedicated kids' pools, a fully equipped gymnasium and outdoor gym, a jogging track, tennis courts, a multi-sports court, and playful additions like croquet, bocce and a giant chess area. Beautifully landscaped grounds, a zen garden, a yoga garden, shaded seating areas, BBQ spots, kids' playgrounds, a nursery, a mosque and round-the-clock security complete this exceptional lifestyle.

Every townhouse at Bianca is finished to an impeccable standard, with premium detailing carried throughout each living space. Interiors feature stylish kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms and en-suites, central air conditioning, double-glazed windows, vanity units with mirrors, and generous built-in wardrobes in the bedrooms. Select residences also enjoy the added comfort of a dedicated laundry and maid's room, along with high-speed fibre-optic connectivity for seamless everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Wadi Al Safa 2, Dubailand, this exceptional location offers residents a cooling shade of a contemporary green community away from the bustle of the city. The area is characterized by its vast wilderness and iridescent emerald hues, where residents can embrace a sense of oneness with nature. The community features a non-linear streetscape with tree-lined sidewalks and foliaged lanes, creating a disruptive optic of visual dynamism.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning within Dubailand, offering residents a serene retreat while maintaining connectivity to key destinations. The meticulously designed interconnected parks and green pathways between the villas are made for kids and pedestrians, creating a safe and community-focused environment. The forest landscape with rustling leaves and fresh green spaces delights the soul with a settled splendor.

For those seeking a residence that embodies serenity, exclusivity, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Reserve delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of woodland community, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can blossom in the glory of the vast wilderness.
